transformations.edit: Extracted the target-local Iter representation from frozen Rust source lines 69-79 into the harness with field names, order, and privacy preserved.

Replaced the unsupported Rust 1.96 `core::ptr::NonNull<T>` field type with a target-local opaque `NonNull<T>` stand-in. The target body does not inspect this field; all pointer/provenance behavior is confined to the trusted `make_slice` boundary.

Replaced the seed string recorder with an executable Verus method whose body is the source body `self.make_slice()`; the only target-signature changes are Verus return naming and the generated contract's ensures clause.

Represented the private macro-expanded helper `make_slice` as an external-body boundary with the exact postcondition needed by the target call. Its pointer arithmetic, `len!` macro expansion, and `from_raw_parts` unsafe preconditions remain trusted rather than hidden inside the target body.
